date_note: Mynavi's page, published 26 November, reports Fuji Television's third report and gives no earlier day for the leak confirmation.
exec: Fuji Television's third report says program-promotion materials leaked from its promotion system; it says they contain no personal information.

sources.name: Mynavi News: Fuji Television confirms leak of part of program-promotion materials (third report)

summary: Fuji Television's third report on unauthorised access to its program-promotion system says part of the promotional materials stored there leaked, Mynavi reports. Fuji says the materials are text prepared for public release and contain no personal information.
title: Fuji Television confirms leak of some program-promotion materials in unauthorised access, third report

validation.note: Only Mynavi News Japan was read; Fuji Television's own report was not found by search.

plain: Fuji Television says some program-promotion materials leaked after unauthorised access to its promotion system. It says they contain no personal information.

review.note: sectors basis stated->inferred (Mynavi names no sector); title, date, no-personal-info statement checked against Mynavi
